QuestInfo.name: Retake the mansion of the Good Witch of the Left-Side!
QuestInfo.0: The Wicked Witch of the Right-Side has taken over the mansion of the Good Witch of the Left-Side. Help Dingshroder take back the mansion.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate the Wicked Witch of the Right-Side and retake the mansion.
QuestInfo.2: You have defeated the Wicked Witch of the Right-Side, and saved the mansion of the Good Witch of the Left-Side. Dingschroder, however, is guarding the mansion all alone. You don't suppose the Wicked Witch of the Right-Side would come back...?
